Remark
[integration by parts for the Laplacian]

Source: petersen:page-0324 ↗ def:pet-ch7-linear-harmonic-function 1. ch7:7.5.12Show that if $u,v:M o \mathbb {R}$ are compactly supported and smooth on open dense sets, then \[ \int u\, \Delta v\, \vol =\int v\, \Delta u\, \vol =-\int g(du,dv)\, \vol =-\int g( abla u, abla v)\, \vol . \]
